highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3-preview.1 improves Linux ARM64 and ahead-of-time application reliability.
highlights_body: It also refreshes bundled image and text dependencies for the 3.119 servicing line.

bullets.lead: Linux ARM64 and AOT crashes fixed
bullets.detail: Packages the required fontconfig runtime for Linux ARM64 and fixes applications built with reflection disabled.
Updates bundled libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and related native dependency sources.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Native binary hardening work for Windows and Linux

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 focused on Linux ARM64 reliability, AOT compatibility, and bundled dependency refreshes.
